[[151 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' establishes that Bazil was nineteen [[Standard year|years]] old during the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which take place in [[132 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TheAcolyteDate|here]]. Therefore, he must have been [[Reproduction|born]] around [[151 BBY]]. |death= |species=[[Tynnan]]{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-creature-shop-bazil-reveal|text=Inside ''The Acolyte'' Creature Shop: Meet Bazil, the Tynnan Tracker - First Details}} |gender= |pronouns=He/him |height=1.17 [[meter]]s{{Databank|bazil|Bazil}} |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] and white{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}} |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin= |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Jedi Order]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|I swear, we need a tracker just to track our tracker.|Yord Fandar, on Bazil|{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}}}} '''Bazil''' was a [[Tynnan]] tracker who was an ally of the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]], he was employed by a team of [[Jedi]] on a [[Mission to Khofar|mission]] to find the [[Wookiee]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Kelnacca]] in the [[jungle]]s of the [[planet]] [[Khofar]]. Led by Master [[Sol]] and accompanied by [[Verosha Aniseya|Verosha "Osha" Aniseya]], the [[Aniseya family|sister]] of the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya|Mae-ho "Mae" Aniseya]]—who was [[Mae's quest|hunting]] down Kelnacca—the group arrived on Khofar, where Bazil began to follow Kelnacca's scent. During the journey, Bazil became separated, encountering Mae and alerting the Jedi. Mae's [[Sith Master]]—an individual known as [[the Stranger]]—then attacked the Jedi, [[Death|killing]] all but Sol in the ensuing [[Lightsaber duel|duel]]. Bazil avoided the skirmish, later finding the head of Osha's [[PIP droid|droid]], [[Pip]]. The Tynnan returned to the Jedi [[Polan-717 Jedi transport|ship]], following Sol and Mae—the latter disguised as her sister—on board. ==Biography== ===Tracking a Wookiee=== {{Quote|How do we find him?''"
"''We have a tracker.|Osha and Fandar, on locating Kelnacca|}} [[File:Day-TheAcolyte-Thumbnail.png|thumb|left|250px|Bazil led members of the Jedi Order into the forests of Khofar in search of Kelnacca.]] The [[Tynnan]] tracker Bazil lived during the [[High Republic Era]] and was an ally of the [[Jedi Order]]. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} he was employed by a group of [[Jedi]] for a [[Mission to Khofar|mission]] to the [[planet]] [[Khofar]] in order to locate the [[Wookiee]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Kelnacca]], who lived in isolation in its [[jungle]]s. The team of Jedi, led by Master [[Sol]], wished to reach Kelnacca before the [[Sith assassin]]{{GermanFanCite|114|Star Wars: The Acolyte: There Are Always Four – No More, No Less…|''Star Wars: The Acolyte'': There Are Always Four – No More, No Less…}} [[Mae-ho Aniseya|Mae-ho "Mae" Aniseya]]{{Acolyte|Destiny (The Acolyte)}} [[Hunting|hunted]] him down as part of her [[Mae's quest|quest]]. Bazil accompanied the group of Jedi, as well as Aniseya's [[Aniseya family|sister]], [[Verosha Aniseya|Verosha "Osha" Aniseya]], aboard a [[Polan-717 Jedi transport]]. As [[Jedi Knight]] [[Yord Fandar]] briefed the Jedi while in [[hyperspace]], Bazil sniffed at Osha's [[PIP droid|droid]], [[Pip]]. The Tynnan roared at the [[droid]], who sprayed a stream of [[water]] into his face. As Bazil wiped his [[Hair|fur]], Osha apologized before stepping aside to ask [[Padawan]] [[Jecki Lon]] about him. After arriving at Khofar, the Jedi learned from the locals that Kelnacca had not been seen after venturing into the [[forest]]. In order to find the Wookiee, Fandar—who was fluent in Bazil's [[Tynnan (language)|Tynnan]]{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}} [[language]]—provided the tracker with a piece of cloth. After sniffing the fabric, Bazil began to lead the Jedi toward Kelnacca. ===Target acquired=== {{Quote|Hey, little buddy.''"
[Bazil roars]|quoteend=0|Mae encounters Bazil|}} [[File:BazilTheTynnan-TheAcolyte.png|thumb|right|200px|Bazil cried out an alert when he found Mae.]] Eventually, Bazil led the others into a grove of [[tree]]s that served as a [[Reproduction|breeding]] ground for an eclipse of [[umbramoth]]s.{{Databank|umbramoth|umbramoth}} Feeling something was rotten about the area, the Tynnan stopped to growl his concerns. Sol urged the group to continue quickly but quietly, though the Jedi were delayed by Osha accidentally disturbing one of the umbramoths, which Sol [[Death|killed]]. Bazil shortly became separated from the Jedi, who were unable to find him. Bazil, his visor down, soon found himself outside [[Kelnacca's shelter]]. Mae, who had decided to turn herself in to Kelnacca, tripped while heading for the shelter, landing in front of Bazil. She greeted the Tynnan, who roared, alerting the Jedi that he had found Mae. The [[assassin]] fled inside the shelter, while the Jedi and Osha rushed to Bazil's location. However, Mae found that Kelnacca had been killed by her [[Sith Master]],{{Acolyte|Night}} an individual known as [[the Stranger]] who soon emerged to attack the Jedi as [[Local day|night]] fell. ===Chaos on Khofar=== {{Quote|Bazil! Come on, let's follow him.|Fandar spots Bazil while escorting Osha to the ship| }} [[File:BazilPip-Acolyte-Night.png|thumb|left|275px|Bazil retrieved Pip's head on Khofar.]] As the Jedi and the Master [[Lightsaber duel|dueled]], Bazil rushed through the forest. Fandar, who had been ordered by Sol to take Osha back to the [[Shuttle|ship]], spotted the tracker, and the pair began to follow him, briefly stopping when Osha insisted they should return to help. After the pair later paused for a second time, they became separated from Bazil once again and eventually returned to the fight. The Master killed all of the Jedi except for Sol in the skirmish, but was carried away by umbramoths that Osha summoned using Pip's disconnected head as a light. Later, Bazil found Pip's head shortly after the Master had slain the umbramoths. As the [[Sith]] walked away, Bazil picked it up and sniffed the droid's head before rushing off. Bazil returned to the Jedi [[starship]], entering shortly after Sol and Mae, the latter having disguised herself as Osha. Carrying Pip's head, the Tynnan stopped in the hallway to sniff the air before following the two. ===Following his nose=== Bazil was able to recognize Mae's deception, and briefly attacked her before fleeing.{{Acolyte|Teach / Corrupt}} During Mae's subsequent absconsion from the Jedi vessel in a stolen escape craft, the Tynnan sabotaged the starship's [[targeting computer]]; both made rough landings on the planet [[Brendok]].{{Acolyte|The Acolyte}} ==Personality and traits== [[File:Bazil-TeachCorrupt.png|thumb|220px|right|Bazil was a tenacious tracker.]] While hunting his quarry, Bazil was tenacious, scampering hurriedly as he led the Jedi on Khofar. He possessed [[Color|brown]] and white fur as well as brown [[eye]]s. Bazil stood at a height of 1.17 [[meter]]s. ==Skills and abilities== Bazil was a natural tracker, possessing a hypersensitive nose that could detect targets at a distance. The Tynnan became separated from the Jedi on multiple occasions while on the hunt, and Fandar felt that they needed another tracker just to track him down. Bazil spoke the Tynnan language. He was able to find a target with one whiff of their scent and would not give up, no matter the danger.{{SW|url=news/bazil-basil-painted-pot-craft|text=You'll Dig This DIY Bazil Basil Planter}} ==Equipment== As a tracker, Bazil wore a visor and helmet that he could use to provide sensory deprivation and focus on his sense of smell. While accompanying the Jedi on Khofar, Bazil donned a gray [[civilian robe|civilian]] [[robe]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|We spoke about those kinds of things. We thought about how we could include some of these things that were not only, you know, cute and lovable and adorable, but also showed signs of a bigger sort of character makeup. A character like this is much more engaging.|Neal Scanlan, on Bazil's design|}} [[File:PottedBazil.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Bazil–themed basil planter, instructions for which were posted on StarWars.com]] Bazil first appeared in "[[Day (episode)|Day]]," the fourth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', released on [[June 18]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=series/the-acolyte/season-1-episode-4-day-episode-guide|text="Day" Episode Guide | The Acolyte}} He was performed by [[Hassan Taj]] and designed by [[Neal Scanlan]] and his team. Pictured in a poster for the series released on [[StarWars.com]] on [[May 4]] of that year,{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-trailer|text=Darkness Rises in ''The Acolyte'' Final Trailer and Key Art}} Bazil was later identified in an article published on [[June 17]] of that year. Although the Disney+ Audio Description for both "Day" and "Night" described Bazil as a Jedi,{{Acolyte|Night}} {{AD|Disney+}} he is depicted wearing a civilian robe, and his entry in the StarWars.com [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] establishes he is an ally of the Order. Instructions for crafting a Bazil–themed basil planter were made available on StarWars.com on [[July 2]], 2024. Bazil's design features elements of [[Wikipedia:Beaver|beavers]] and [[Wikipedia:Otter|otters]] in order to match the description of his species, which [[Tynnan/Legends|originated]] in the [[1979]] novel ''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]'' by [[Brian Daley]]. The Tynnan's role in the story influenced his design, with a prominent snout to track his quarries and a visor and helmet that provided sensory deprivation in order to focus on his task. [[Wikipedia:Marty Feldman|Marty Feldman's]] [[Wikipedia:Igor (character)|Igor]] in the comedy [[Wikipedia:Young Frankenstein|''Young Frankenstein'']], possessing a small stature but a large personality, was another inspiration, leading Bazil's scenes to be shot in a way that gave him an equal presence to those around him. ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:BazilConcept1-TomBlake.jpg|Concept design by [[Tom Blake|T.
